The recording starts by launching the submitted Mac build and demonstrates all three features, timer audio import/completion, and the policy link.

2. Purpose and audience
Prelis Desktop combines a private diary, countdown timer, and password generator for general Mac App Store users. Users can record their day, time work/study sessions, and generate passwords without an account. It is not restricted to any business, organization, or employee group.

3. Access, setup, and instructions
No registration, login, demo credentials, subscription, or in-app purchase is required. There is no account creation/deletion flow. Core features work offline; the policy website requires internet access.

Diary: Select Diary in the left sidebar. Select a date, enter sample text, and click 保存 (Save). Move to another date and return to confirm persistence. Entries and imported audio are private local content. There is no posting, publication, sharing, messaging, or interaction with other users.

Timer: Select Timer. Expand 終了音 (Completion sound) > 音声を追加 (Add audio) and select review-tone.wav in the macOS file chooser. MP3/WAV up to 10 MiB are supported. The imported sound is selected automatically; click 試聴 (Preview). Set 1 minute and click 開始 (Start); the same button pauses/resumes. Switching sidebar features preserves timing. Keep Prelis running and the Mac awake until completion, then click リセット (Reset) to stop the sound. Without a selected sound, completion is silent. Quitting resets the timer; it does not provide an alarm while the Mac is asleep or Prelis is not running.
Original test WAV: [REVIEW_TONE_ATTACHMENT_OR_DOWNLOAD_URL]
Save review-tone.wav to the Mac before importing it. Diary/Password need no sample file.

Password: Select Password. Choose uppercase/lowercase letters, numbers and/or symbols, and 4/8/12/16 characters. 間違えやすい文字を除く excludes ambiguous characters. Click パスワードを生成 (Generate password), then コピー (Copy). Generation uses device Web Crypto randomness. Copying writes to the system clipboard; results are not persisted for future launches.

Privacy policy: Click プライバシーポリシー (Privacy Policy) at the bottom of the sidebar, accessible from all feature screens. It opens https://prelis.prj.kupac.co.jp/privacy in the default external browser.

4. External services/tools/platforms
Tauri (Rust/macOS WKWebView), React, Tauri File System (local diary/audio storage), Tauri Opener (external browser), HTMLAudioElement (local playback), and Web Crypto/Clipboard APIs.
Core features use no external backend, authentication, payment, AI, data-provider, advertising, or analytics services. No app-managed cloud sync. The separate policy/marketing site is prelis.prj.kupac.co.jp; support uses Google Forms. These websites are not needed for core features. No Expo/mobile SDKs are used.

5. Regional behavior
Features/content are consistent across distribution regions, with no regional feature gates. The current UI is Japanese with English feature names. Diary dates follow the Mac's local date.

6. Regulated services/third-party material
No financial, medical, gambling, or VPN service is provided. There is no third-party media catalog, music download, or streaming service. Timer sounds are user-selected files for local use. The supplied review-tone.wav was synthesized specifically for review and contains no third-party recording. Third-party software components are subject to their respective licenses.
